title: Non-overlapping Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals, return the minimum number of intervals to remove so that the remaining intervals do not overlap.

reference.use_case: Removing the fewest bookings so that none of the remaining ones conflict, such as keeping the most meetings possible in a single room.
system_examples: Room and resource booking systems — resolving double-bookings while keeping as many reservations as possible
Broadcast and ad scheduling — selecting the most non-conflicting slots on a single channel
Single-machine job scheduling — maximizing the number of jobs completed
reference.explanation: Sort by end time and greedily keep each interval that starts after the last kept one ends; finishing earliest leaves the most room, which maximizes the number kept (classic interval scheduling). Removals = total − kept, in O(n log n).
